label: L-09
title: ERC4626 vault used as price oracle in surplus and skimSurplus calculations — two consecutive convertToAssets calls in the same transaction may return different rates for time-weighted vaults, causing revert
description: Inside _skimSurplus, vault.convertToAssets is called at the top to snapshot totalValue, and again at the bottom to compute minOut from totalShares. For vaults with accrual-triggered rates, these two calls can return different rates within the same transaction. If the second call returns a higher rate, minOut becomes unsatisfiable and the swap reverts.
impact: Temporary DoS on skimSurplus — no fund loss, retry resolves it. Narrow sub-case of M-02's broader vault oracle risk.
attackPath: _skimSurplus calls vault.convertToAssets at top of function for totalValue snapshot
Vault accrual triggers mid-transaction, increasing rate
Second convertToAssets call at minOut computation returns higher value
minOut > actual swap output; swap reverts
